data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hello,

Your fund's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in CBK, PROV, and COSO.

On October 15, 2026, MAYS disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/54187/000120677426000561/mays4703791-8k.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only, never issuer-paid. May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot?

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
